struct Edge {
    int from, to, capacity, cost, flow;
    Edge* complement;
    Edge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) : from(from), to(to), capacity(capacity), cost(cost), flow(0), complement(nullptr) {}
};

class MinHeap {
public:
    vector<int> a, map, imap;
    int n, pos;
    static const int INF = INT_MAX;
    
    MinHeap(int m) {
        n = m + 2;
        a.resize(n, INF);
        map.resize(n, -1);
        imap.resize(n, -1);
        pos = 1;
    }
    
    int add(int ind, int x) {
        int ret = imap[ind];
        if (imap[ind] < 0) {
            a[pos] = x;
            map[pos] = ind;
            imap[ind] = pos;
            pos++;
            up(pos - 1);
        }
        return ret != -1 ? a[ret] : x;
    }
    
    int update(int ind, int x) {
        int ret = imap[ind];
        if (imap[ind] < 0) {
            a[pos] = x;
            map[pos] = ind;
            imap[ind] = pos;
            pos++;
            up(pos - 1);
        } else {
            int o = a[ret];
            a[ret] = x;
            up(ret);
            down(ret);
        }
        return x;
    }
    
    int remove(int ind) {
        if (pos == 1) return INF;
        if (imap[ind] == -1) return INF;
        pos--;
        int rem = imap[ind];
        int ret = a[rem];
        map[rem] = map[pos];
        imap[map[pos]] = rem;
        imap[ind] = -1;
        a[rem] = a[pos];
        a[pos] = INF;
        map[pos] = -1;
        up(rem);
        down(rem);
        return ret;
    }
    
    int min() { return a[1]; }
    int argmin() { return map[1]; }
    int size() { return pos - 1; }
    
private:
    void up(int cur) {
        for (int c = cur, p = c >> 1; p >= 1 && a[p] > a[c]; c >>= 1, p >>= 1) {
            swap(a[p], a[c]);
            swap(imap[map[p]], imap[map[c]]);
            swap(map[p], map[c]);
        }
    }
    
    void down(int cur) {
        for (int c = cur; 2 * c < pos; ) {
            int b = (2 * c + 1 < pos && a[2 * c + 1] < a[2 * c]) ? 2 * c + 1 : 2 * c;
            if (a[b] < a[c]) {
                swap(a[c], a[b]);
                swap(imap[map[c]], imap[map[b]]);
                swap(map[c], map[b]);
                c = b;
            } else break;
        }
    }
};

vector<vector<Edge*>> compileWD(int n, vector<Edge*>& edges) {
    for (int i = edges.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        Edge* origin = edges[i];
        Edge* clone = new Edge(origin->to, origin->from, origin->capacity, -origin->cost);
        clone->flow = origin->capacity;
        clone->complement = origin;
        origin->complement = clone;
        edges.push_back(clone);
    }
    
    vector<int> p(n, 0);
    for (Edge* e : edges) p[e->from]++;
    
    vector<vector<Edge*>> g(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i].resize(p[i]);
    
    vector<int> cnt(n, 0);
    for (Edge* e : edges) {
        g[e->from][cnt[e->from]++] = e;
    }
    
    return g;
}

ll solveMinCostFlow(vector<vector<Edge*>>& g, int source, int sink, ll all) {
    int n = g.size();
    ll mincost = 0;
    vector<int> potential(n, 0);
    vector<int> d(n);
    
    MinHeap q(n);
    
    while (all > 0) {
        vector<Edge*> inedge(n, nullptr);
        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), INT_MAX / 2);
        d[source] = 0;
        q.add(source, 0);
        
        while (q.size() > 0) {
            int cur = q.argmin();
            q.remove(cur);
            for (Edge* ne : g[cur]) {
                if (ne->capacity - ne->flow > 0) {
                    int nd = d[cur] + ne->cost + potential[cur] - potential[ne->to];
                    if (d[ne->to] > nd) {
                        inedge[ne->to] = ne;
                        d[ne->to] = nd;
                        q.update(ne->to, nd);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inedge[sink] == nullptr) break;
        
        ll minflow = all;
        ll sumcost = 0;
        for (Edge* e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            if (e->capacity - e->flow < minflow) minflow = e->capacity - e->flow;
            sumcost += e->cost;
        }
        
        mincost += minflow * sumcost;
        for (Edge* e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            e->flow += minflow;
            e->complement->flow -= minflow;
        }
        all -= minflow;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) potential[i] += d[i];
    }
    
    return mincost;
}

class FastScanner {
private:
    static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1024;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int lenbuf, ptrbuf;
    FILE* file;
    
public:
    FastScanner() : lenbuf(0), ptrbuf(0) {
        file = stdin;
    }
    
    int readByte() {
        if (lenbuf == -1) throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (ptrbuf >= lenbuf) {
            ptrbuf = 0;
            lenbuf = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, file);
            if (lenbuf <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[ptrbuf++];
    }
    
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) { return !(c >= 33 && c <= 126); }
    
    int skip() {
        int b;
        while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && isSpaceChar(b));
        return b;
    }
    
    string ns() {
        int b = skip();
        string s;
        while (b != -1 && !isSpaceChar(b)) {
            s += (char)b;
            b = readByte();
        }
        return s;
    }
    
    vector<char> ns(int n) {
        vector<char> buf(n);
        int b = skip(), p = 0;
        while (p < n && b != -1 && !isSpaceChar(b)) {
            buf[p++] = (char)b;
            b = readByte();
        }
        if (n == p) return buf;
        buf.resize(p);
        return buf;
    }
    
    int ni() {
        int num = 0, b;
        bool minus = false;
        while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
        
        if (b == '-') {
            minus = true;
            b = readByte();
        }
        
        while (true) {
            if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
                num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
            } else {
                return minus ? -num : num;
            }
            b = readByte();
        }
    }
    
    vector<int> na(int n) {
        vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = ni();
        return a;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner scanner;
    
    int n = scanner.ni();
    vector<char> s_vec = scanner.ns(n);
    string s(s_vec.begin(), s_vec.end());
    
    vector<int> f(26, 0);
    for (char c : s) f[c - 'a']++;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        if (f[i] > n / 2) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    
    vector<int> a = scanner.na(n);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        if (a[i] > a[n - 1 - i]) {
            swap(a[i], a[n - 1 - i]);
            swap(s[i], s[n - 1 - i]);
        }
    }
    
    int src = n, sink = n + 1;
    int totalEdges = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        totalEdges += 2 + (n / 2);
    }
    
    vector<Edge*> edges;
    edges.reserve(totalEdges);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        edges.push_back(new Edge(src, i, 1, 0));
        edges.push_back(new Edge(n - 1 - i, sink, 1, 0));
        for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; j++) {
            if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - j]) {
                edges.push_back(new Edge(i, n - 1 - j, 1, i == j ? 0 : a[i]));
            }
        }
    }
    
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int x : a) ans += x;
    
    auto graph = compileWD(sink + 1, edges);
    ll minCost = solveMinCostFlow(graph, src, sink, n);
    
    cout << ans - minCost << endl;
    
    for (Edge* e : edges) delete e;
    
    return 0;
}
